commit.message:
Retain surface rebase coverage across terminal worker failure

Assert that failed worker surface publication remains terminal until fresh initialization. Preserve lower-level lossless recovery with a real deformed Simulation and SurfaceChannel, including exact terrain reconstruction after incremental changes are consumed. Maintain this adjacent contract in the focused engine workflow.

Verify renderer ownership fixtures and terminal worker recovery

Extend existing fixtures to supply and verify owned output-pass, sky and shadow resources. Preserve the terminal worker contract after frame failure and assert fresh pool capacity after reinitialization. Add all three affected legacy test files to the focused engine workflow; retain the original failed run and baseline comparison as validation evidence.
Harden engine callback ownership and reduce CSV export memory
Measure engine kernels and retain exact-output performance evidence
Verify native engine ownership and retain focused runtime gates
Bound worker channels and harden engine session and replay ownership
Reduce engine allocations and close texture, GPU and audio lifetimes
Share network snapshots and preserve controller edge ordering
Fix engine rewind clocks, bounded ghosts and discrete network input

Improve atomic physics staging and verify worker ownership

Remove five private staging vectors while preserving exact accepted dynamics and failure atomicity. Reset circuit timing diagnostics on reinitialization. Add combined rewind, surface-consumer and independent clock-conservation checks.

Retain complete timing distributions, independent performance/provenance review and native worker CI evidence. Record the local complete compiler's memory interruption explicitly; exact-source remote compilation remains a required gate. Models, characters, environments and tuning are unchanged.

fix(engine): isolate renderer startup generations and preserve construction failures

Keep asynchronous renderer candidates private until their session and request still own the host. Retire obsolete candidates, suppress stale progress and preserve active failure identity. Preserve original construction errors when partial-renderer cleanup also fails.

Add actual native worker transfer/backpressure/rewind gates and retain independent rigid-step cost/exactness measurements, including measured safety overhead. Focused integration suites and complete staged-source TypeScript check passed (2.5 GiB compiler heap). The preceding source passed eleven native tests and global validation. No authored models, character assets, environments or tuning changed.

fix(engine): retire audio automation and recheck session ownership after input actions

Cancel all fixed oscillator target timelines when resetting presentation audio, preserving existing synthesis and fade. Recheck Festival owner identity and driving state after callbacks can synchronously close a session, retaining the original transport failure.

Add native OfflineAudioContext rendering gates, actual controller/session integration and bounded client/server outage/rejoin tests. Correct subprocess fixture imports without disabling lint or assertions. Full staged-source TypeScript compilation and focused regressions pass; native audio assertions run in the focused CI gate. Authored content is unchanged.

perf(engine): remove prediction temporaries and preserve audio and controller continuity

Use scalar response-model arithmetic with exact numerical equivalence, preserve low-rate audio elapsed time with explicit discontinuity cleanup, and neutralize established controller replacements before accepting held inputs.

Add actual-track collision construction benchmarks and real subprocess save-recovery checks, retaining source identities, timing distributions and failure limits. Full TypeScript validation passed on the immutable staged snapshot. The preceding replay fix passed all eight native browser checks. No authored models, environments, character assets or vehicle/audio tuning changed.

fix(engine): bound network retention and secure audio and replay ownership

Bound diagnostic samples and stale-ACK command history; copy authoritative and remote states at ownership boundaries. Retire all transient audio voices and scheduled filter work on reset or disposal. Recover exact replay endpoints after native range serialization. Preserve deterministic wire, render and interpolation outputs, and record cold-start trace evidence without relaxing browser assertions.

Validated focused regressions and complete TypeScript compilation on an immutable staged snapshot. Native endpoint regression runs in the focused runtime workflow. No authored models, environments, vehicle calibration or sound profiles changed.
